title: Materiel for the front
description: The Commission buys guns at the front. Three Medium Artillery units to the Hauvnok staging yard — Dukšan's office hands out the order at standing 0.15, and the war takes everything that arrives.

title: Clear the front
description: Two Marauders are working the Kvonice belt where the fleets need the room. Kill both, dock at Dukšan, and the Commission settles at standing 0.20.
